steps.title: Check what will be pushed and the CI triggers

body.command: cd /c/Dot; git status --short | head -60; git branch --show-current; grep -n -A4 "^on:" .github/workflows/ci.yml

steps.title: Scan the changes for secrets before pushing

body.command: cd /c/Dot; git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; echo ---; (git diff; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | xargs cat) | grep -nE "apikey_[0-9a-fA-F]{8,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|00000000-0000" | head; echo "scan done"

steps.title: Commit to a new next branch and push it

body.command:
cd /c/Dot; git switch -q -c next && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Next: double-check test results (Jev, Laya), Simple view, setup choices

- Test results come from the output via runner parsers (adapted from
  claude-referee by Ismail Dasci, MIT); "unclear" is never a pass; each verdict
  says where it came from.
- Optional checker for unclear runs: Cloud (TypeSafe Jev, your key) or Local
  (Laya, one-click setup). Its answers show in sessions, the Log, the pal's Tools
  tab, an Overview tile and Settings → Recent checks.
- Simple and Detailed views of each request (pal, notch, dashboard); small steps
  fold away.
- A command counts for what it runs, not text it writes into a file; temp and
  build folder deletes are quiet notes; `timeout N npm test` counts as a test.
- Setup asks a few choices in the terminal (--yes keeps the defaults).
- The dizzy pal says so; clipped output keeps its start and end.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <[REDACTED:email]>
EOF
git push -q -u origin next 2>&1 | tail -2; git log --oneline -1; git branch --show-current

steps.title: Wait for CI on the next branch

body.command: cd /c/Dot; sleep 10; id=$(gh run list --branch next --limit 5 --json databaseId,headSha,workflowName --jq '.[] | select(.headSha | startswith("f657533")) | select(.workflowName=="CI") | .databaseId' | head -1); echo "run $id"; gh run watch "$id" --exit-status --interval 15 > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; gh run view "$id" --json conclusion,jobs --jq '.conclusion, (.jobs[] | "\(.name): \(.conclusion)")'

steps.title: Read the failing tests from the CI logs

body.command: cd /c/Dot; gh run view 36897932015 --log-failed 2>/dev/null | grep -E "✖|not ok|AssertionError|actual|expected|Error:" | sed 's/^[^\t]*\t[^\t]*\t//' | grep -v "^\s*$" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -30

steps.title: Show the failing assertion and find the test

body.command: cd /c/Dot; gh run view 36897932015 --log-failed 2>/dev/null | grep -A22 "not ok 72" | head -26 | sed 's/^[^\t]*\t[^\t]*\t[^ ]* //'; grep -n "a server left running by an earlier bridge" test/laya.test.js

steps.title: Check which OS the fake system and manager assume

body.command: cd /c/Dot; grep -n "function fakeSystem" -A30 test/laya.test.js | grep -n "platform\|createLaya\|Scripts\|bin" | head; grep -n "platform" bridge/laya.js | head -8

steps.title: Look for other managers missing the platform

body.command: cd /c/Dot; grep -n "createLaya({" test/laya.test.js | head; grep -c "platform" test/laya.test.js

steps.title: Run the Laya tests as Linux, then the full suite

body.command: cd /c/Dot; printf "Object.defineProperty(process, 'platform', { value: 'linux' });\n" > "$TEMP/as-linux.mjs"; timeout 120 node --import "file:///$(cygpath -m "$TEMP/as-linux.mjs")" --test test/laya.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^ℹ (pass|fail)|^not ok|✖" | head; timeout 150 npm test > "$TEMP/t.out" 2>&1; grep -E "^ℹ (pass|fail)" "$TEMP/t.out"
body.output:
ℹ pass 9
ℹ fail 0
ℹ pass 141
ℹ fail 0

steps.title: Push the fix and wait for CI

body.command:
cd /c/Dot; git add test/laya.test.js && git commit -q -m "test: the restarted Laya manager uses the same pretend OS as the first (failed on macOS and Linux)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <[REDACTED:email]>" && git push -q origin next && sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && echo "pushed $sha" && sleep 10 && id=$(gh run list --branch next --limit 5 --json databaseId,headSha,workflowName --jq ".[] | select(.headSha | startswith(\"$sha\")) | select(.workflowName==\"CI\") | .databaseId" | head -1) && echo "run $id" && gh run watch "$id" --exit-status --interval 15 > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; gh run view "$id" --json conclusion,jobs --jq '.conclusion, (.jobs[] | "\(.name): \(.conclusion)")'

end.title: Finished
end.summary:
eck the pal, the notch, the Simple/Detailed switch, the dashboard and Jev. Tell me what works and what doesn't, and I'll fix it on `next`.

When you're happy, I'll merge `next` into `main` and release it as v0.9.3. Only when you say "ship".
